cross_field_rules: participant IDs and logical control IDs must be unique and ordinally sorted
threshold sign and comparison semantics are fixed by constraint_kind
sampling policy must cover domain endpoints, default, and independently justified interior extrema
control_mappings must cover every exact V2 logical control exactly once in accepted order
no V2 null implementation field or static V4 schema field may be promoted into an acquired fact
receipt authentication covers every nested mapping, channel, range, convention, symmetry, independence, and collision field
component must occur exactly once in the future binary inventory receipt
component_stable_id must be unique across the acquired rig
all strings must match the binary inspection result byte-for-byte after NFC validation
up_axis and forward_axis must name different unsigned axes
basis_matrix_row_major must be an independently checked invertible homogeneous transform
convention_root_sha256 must bind the canonical values of every preceding field
body and rig hashes must be independently computed from future acquired bytes
V4 is only a static boundary identity and cannot fill any actual body, rig, build, or inspection field
rig_identity_root_sha256 must bind the complete canonical object excluding itself
channel_count must equal channels length and channel IDs must be globally unique
group/control ordinal and IDs must match the exact accepted V2 order
control_default_vector is the concatenation of channel default values in channel order
all four numeric vectors must have exactly value_arity entries
value_arity must be between one and four inclusive
minimum_inclusive <= default_value <= maximum_inclusive componentwise
values must be finite JSON numbers and negative zero is forbidden
units must agree with the exact channel property and coordinate convention
BONE_TRANSFORM requires armature and bone names and null mesh/shape-key names
SHAPE_KEY_VALUE requires mesh and shape-key names and null armature/bone names
ACTION_FCURVE requires action binding and an exact non-null action name
rna_data_path and array_index must resolve exactly once against the future inspected rig
channel ordinals must be contiguous within the logical control record
LEFT or RIGHT requires exact mirror partner IDs; other lateralities require both partner fields null
CUSTOM_SIGN_VECTOR requires a sign entry for every channel component; other rules require custom_sign_vector null
shared_physical_channel and independently_addressable may not both be true
independence receipt must test unilateral actuation and cross-talk against declared tolerances
auditor must be genuinely different from the V3 author and must independently implement parsing and validation
audit receipt cannot grant body, rig, runtime, Blender, audio, runner, publication, or GO authority
deterministic replay must compare canonical timing/control sample bytes without executing a live runner
value arity, units, quantization, and range must match the authenticated channel mapping
events must be contiguous, non-overlapping, strictly ordered, and cover exact logical ordinals zero through thirty-nine
every sample must bind the exact acquired mapping and actual future rig identity
person_id, body_artifact_sha256, rig_artifact_sha256, and rig_identity_root_sha256 must equal the authenticated mapping receipt values
no keyboard, mouse, gamepad, motion-capture, MIDI, OSC, facial-capture, or other control-device input may source the deterministic samples
F06, audio, voice models, cameras, microphones, and recordings are excluded
channel_sample_count and channel order must exactly match the authenticated logical control mapping
tick fraction must be reduced to lowest terms
all event and frame times must be exact integers in this clock
no wall clock, audio clock, camera clock, Blender frame clock, or inferred timing is permitted
event identity must exactly match accepted V2 logical ordinal, phase, and case
end_tick_exclusive must equal start_tick plus duration_ticks
sample_count must equal sample_frames length
first frame tick_offset must be zero and final frame must be strictly before end_tick_exclusive
control_samples must cover all 52 controls exactly once in accepted V2 order
absolute_tick must equal event start_tick plus tick_offset
sample ordinals must be contiguous and ticks strictly increasing within the event

scope_statement: Append-only successor to the rejected Facial V3 boundary: preserves its otherwise-passing exact V2 control, F00-F05 timeline, recursively closed future receipt, equal-person/no-control-device, F06-disabled, and all-null authority boundaries while correcting the accepted static Intended-Body/Rig V4 audit-complete-root label.
